heroHeadline: June 1: PLA Rebounds to 8 Sorties (2/8 Cross Median SW/E ADIZ) After May 31 Single-Sortie Pullback — 7 PLAN Vessels + 4 Ships; HIMARS NT$800M Payment MET May 31; Full Sequence: ...→16→1→8
heroSubtitle: On June 1, 2026, Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 8 PLA aircraft sorties (up from May 31's single-sortie 'HIMARS deadline day' pullback), with 2 of the 8 crossing the Taiwan Strait median line into the southwestern and eastern ADIZ sectors. Seven PLAN vessels and 4 official ships operated around Taiwan — a slight naval reduction from May 31's 8 PLAN vessels + 4 ships while sustaining multi-vector maritime pressure. The June 1 rebound is consistent with the PLA's established post-pullback moderate recovery pattern: the 8-sortie count with a 25% crossing rate (2/8) represents calibrated ongoing pressure well below May 30's surge of 16 sorties (44% crossing rate). The key milestone: Taiwan successfully met the May 31 HIMARS NT$800 million down payment deadline — for all 82 HIMARS launchers — backed by Executive Yuan emergency reserve funds following the Legislative Yuan's passage of the NT$8.81B FY2026 special procurement budget on May 29 without opposition. The extended May→June sortie sequence now reads: 4→29→1→2→1→0→22→12→8→12→7→9→2→3→15→6→7→13→24→7→6→16→4→9→26→10→9→10→16→1→8. US FMS pause for Operation Epic Fury (Iran) remains active; the $14B PAC-3/NASAMS package remains 'in abeyance' (Trump); no Trump-Lai direct call has been confirmed as of June 1.
